card.name: Small words in historical literary prose
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, by, with, to, the, they, or a first name, in older history, biography or literary prose. The next word is often a name, title or noun of the period.

modes.label: Linking words in history
modes.description: Words like of, by, with or they in narrative about historical events and people.
modes.example: Barron was in turn replaced<< by>> William Eaton, who hired a mercenary

modes.label: Literary biography
modes.description: Small words in poet biographies, before magazine titles, family names or published works.
modes.example: he published a sonnet in<< The>> European Magazine.

modes.label: Poetry and old recipes
modes.description: Small words in verse lines and old-style recipe text.
modes.example: in half a pint<< of>> white wine; put a thin puff-p

card.writes: It weakly pushes word starts like Dict, Signing and dictated, and suppresses others, with no clear shared meaning.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in old-fashioned history, biography and poetry, just before a name or noun.
